hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'git push'; then git fetch origin main --quiet 2>/dev/null && git rebase origin/main --quiet 2>/dev/null || { echo '{"continue": false, "stopReason": "Auto-rebase onto origin/main failed — resolve conflicts before pushing."}'; exit 1; }; fi
